name: Qwen 3.5 Flash
short: Alibaba's hosted Qwen3.5-Flash tier - the production profile of the open 35B-A3B weights with 1M context by default; GPQA 82.8%, LiveCodeBench 83.3% (Vals).
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: A 1M-context multimodal tier from 3B-active weights, priced like a small model.
tradeoff: Terminal-Bench 2.0 24.7% and FrontierMath Tiers 1-3 18.2% are weak, and the open 35B-A3B weights score higher on agentic suites - this is a hosted serving profile, not new weights.
pricingTiers: Alibaba Model Studio $0.10/M in, $0.40/M out (intl); $0.029/$0.287 in the China region with context tiers
